title: Comprehensive insights into the impact of straw types, temperature and atmosphere on pyrochar properties and its enhancement potential for anaerobic digestion
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00589B, Paper
Ruixia Shen, Jie Liu, Zonglu Yao, Jing Feng, Jiadong Yu, Juan Luo, Lixin Zhao
Corn stover-600-CO2 pyrochar had the highest specific surface area of 131 m2 g−1, and an excellent electrical conductivity with 781 Ω cm resistivity. The highest CH4 production rate was obtained in AD enhanced with corn stover-450-N2 pyrochar.
